# Telecid
> Russian-language site for TV channels, online broadcasts, and program schedules.

Telecid aggregates television channel pages, live stream access, and schedule-oriented navigation for Russian-speaking users looking up channels and broadcasts.

## Main
- [Home](https://telecid.ru/): Main entry point for browsing channels, streams, and TV-related content.
- [Channels](https://telecid.ru/kanaly/): Directory of television channels available on the site.
- [Online TV](https://telecid.ru/onlajn-tv/): Collection of online TV stream pages and live viewing links.
- [TV Program](https://telecid.ru/teleprogramma/): Schedule-focused section for television programming and listings.

## Channel Directory
- [First Channel](https://telecid.ru/kanaly/pervyj-kanal/): Channel page with stream and schedule-related information for Pervyy Kanal.
- [Russia 1](https://telecid.ru/kanaly/rossiya-1/): Channel page for Rossiya 1 with broadcast access and related details.
- [NTV](https://telecid.ru/kanaly/ntv/): Dedicated NTV page with online viewing and channel information.
- [TNT](https://telecid.ru/kanaly/tnt/): TNT channel page with stream access and programming context.
- [STS](https://telecid.ru/kanaly/sts/): STS channel page for live viewing and schedule lookup.
- [REN TV](https://telecid.ru/kanaly/ren-tv/): REN TV page with channel overview and online broadcast links.

## Online Streams
- [First Channel Live](https://telecid.ru/onlajn-tv/pervyj-kanal-onlajn/): Live stream page for Pervyy Kanal online viewing.
- [Russia 1 Live](https://telecid.ru/onlajn-tv/rossiya-1-onlajn/): Online broadcast page for Rossiya 1 live stream access.
- [NTV Live](https://telecid.ru/onlajn-tv/ntv-onlajn/): NTV online stream page for direct live viewing.
- [TNT Live](https://telecid.ru/onlajn-tv/tnt-onlajn/): TNT live stream page with embedded or linked broadcast access.
- [STS Live](https://telecid.ru/onlajn-tv/sts-onlajn/): STS online viewing page for live television access.
- [REN TV Live](https://telecid.ru/onlajn-tv/ren-tv-onlajn/): REN TV live stream page with online broadcast access.

## TV Schedules
- [First Channel Schedule](https://telecid.ru/teleprogramma/pervyj-kanal/): Program schedule page for Pervyy Kanal broadcasts.
- [Russia 1 Schedule](https://telecid.ru/teleprogramma/rossiya-1/): TV listings page for Rossiya 1 programming.
- [NTV Schedule](https://telecid.ru/teleprogramma/ntv/): Broadcast schedule page for NTV shows and airtimes.
- [TNT Schedule](https://telecid.ru/teleprogramma/tnt/): TNT programming schedule with current and upcoming shows.
- [STS Schedule](https://telecid.ru/teleprogramma/sts/): STS listings page for daily television programming.
- [REN TV Schedule](https://telecid.ru/teleprogramma/ren-tv/): REN TV schedule page with show times and listings.

- [TV Center](https://telecid.ru/kanaly/tvcz/): TVC channel page with online viewing and related details.
- [Russia 24](https://telecid.ru/kanaly/rossiya-24/): News-focused Rossiya 24 channel page.

- [Domashniy](https://telecid.ru/kanaly/domashnij/): Domashniy channel page with viewing and schedule context.

## Entertainment Channels
